text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Dong, dong...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer is coming to an end. The summer the 
three of us spent together with Hishi 
Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle struggled at first, but when 
all is said and done...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... *wheeze*... So tough... 
But still...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I think I might've gotten a bit better at 
keeping up with No Reason-chan~."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! You've improved quite a lot, 
Mirako! I certainly can't afford to slack 
off either, now can I!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Who knows, the one who actually ends up 
winning the Kikuka Sho might just be 
Mira-ko.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, come on~, you're exaggerating...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even while giving a shy laugh, Hishi 
Miracle looked happy. She must have felt 
the solid results of her efforts.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, autumn is certainly something 
to look forward to. Lord Gimlet and Lord 
Kris S are waiting, after all.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
No one has any idea who will win the 
Kikuka-sho! After a chaotic, tangled 
slugfest—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If I win, magnificent! If I am bested, 
magnificent all the same!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to make this the greatest banquet 
our generation has ever seen! Don't you 
agree, Miracle?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, you're right. I don't really get 
it, but it'd be great if it turns out 
nice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason was talking happily. Seeing her 
like that...
choice_data_list: That was a bit unexpected, maybe.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Surprising? What is?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I thought No Reason was the type who'd be 
fine with anything as long as she won, but 
surprisingly, she seemed to genuinely look 
forward to the contest itself."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, since it is a battle, one 
must emerge victorious. However—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Before all that, we must put up a good 
fight. Unless it's a fiery battle, nothing 
of worth will remain."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run through our era without any 
regrets. And in that time..."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Only by shining the brightest will my 
running endure. Is that not so, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: No, I think you're totally right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason is surprisingly living her youth 
to the fullest. In that case, I want to 
let her have a race she's satisfied with 
before moving forward.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Still, Trainer. As much as I'm looking 
forward to the next race, the Kikuka 
Sho... I also can't help feeling that 
anything could happen...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Only by overcoming that can we advance 
toward the era we strive for. Which is to 
say—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
An era where my running shall be carried 
on for eternity!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"That is the very dawn of this nation I've 
been waiting for! Nya-hahaha!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I want to see it, Trainer. A new sunrise. 
And—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: “I wish to laugh. Together with thee.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The era of No Reason. Before ushering that 
in, first...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I must overcome the Kikuka Sho standing 
before me. But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason—the waves looked high. 
Impossibly high.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A premonition of a storm. No Reason 
simply stared steadily at the waves.
